Our 2027 Conferences

Two conferences, one focused community

Business of Class Actions Europe
Porto  |  19 February 2027

A one-day conference focused on real collective-action cases, cross-border litigation, qualified entities, settlements, economics, litigation funding and defence strategies.

Expected audience: 80+ participants
Business of Competition
Prague  |  April 2027

A two-day conference connecting competition practitioners, economists, regulators, businesses and funders through practical discussions of enforcement, litigation and digital markets.

Expected audience: 80–100 participants
